info.name: dx-dataplane-ogc · v2 Auth E2E
info.description:
End-to-end test collection for dx-dataplane-ogc with the new v2 auth (JWT + Basic AppId + delegation) and gRPC item-access.

## Quick start
1. Set the collection variables (baseUrl, keycloakTokenUrl, clientId, clientSecret, username, password, collectionId, etc.).
2. Run **00 · Auth & Token → Keycloak · Get User Token** first — it saves `accessToken` automatically.
3. Run any other folder; secured requests use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` or Basic `{{appId}}:{{appSecret}}`.

## Simple usage (DX consumer/provider token)
You do NOT need Keycloak/AppId/delegation to use this collection: paste any valid DX JWT into the `accessToken` variable (or use the DX-AAA request in folder 00) and every secured request works. Use a **consumer** token for the read folders (02, 05, 07, 09) and a **provider** token for the write folders (03, 06, 11). Ignore the Basic AppId / `did` requests if you are not on the v2-auth deployment.

## Learning path
Read docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE_2.md alongside this collection: folder 01 = discovery counters, 02/07 = Features, 04/05/06 = STAC, 11 = the provider stories of §12, in runnable form.

## Notes
- `baseUrl` defaults to `http://localhost:8080` (local). For dev use `https://v2.dev.ogc.iudx.io`.
- Delegation (`did`) item-access tests are marked **KNOWN GAP**: they currently return 403 because OGC sends (delegator,delegator) to CheckItemAccess. They should pass once the delegated-item-access bridge is applied.
- Status-code assertions are intentionally lenient (oneOf) where the exact code depends on your data (OPEN vs RESTRICTED dataset, granted vs denied).

item.description: The full provider story in order, with the REAL input body of every process: presigned upload → CollectionOnboarding → job polling → verify features → tiles generation → STAC collection/item + multipart asset upload → attribute extraction. Needs only a provider Bearer token in {{accessToken}} plus {{resourceId}} (and {{stacResourceId}} for the STAC steps). Run Step 0 first — it captures process ids. Mirrors the stories in docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE_2.md §12.
